# Authored native regression fixtures

These files are owned by the permanent Rust regression suite. Their byte hashes
and original provenance are recorded in `tests/contract/fixtures.json`; moving
them here did not regenerate or normalize them. The original Go baseline commit
is recorded in the contract metadata. They are static inputs and expected values,
not an executable reference dependency. Historical text/HTML goldens remain
available as provenance; native CLI/Markdown semantic assertions own the intended
current presentation.
